{{Top}}
'''Ozone''' was a triatomic [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] molecule that was created by excess energy in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], often caused by the firing of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser]] and [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster]] weapons, as well as the use of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. The gas had an odor which was pungent and noticeable. Ozone odors were also known to precede [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]].

Many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] had a layer of ozone in their upper atmosphere; [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] was one such example. This ozone restricted [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] light's ability to pass freely to the surface of a planet. Some planets, such as [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]], lacked a layer of ozone in their atmosphere. On Af'El, the native [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] adapted to this by developing the ability to see in the ultraviolet spectrum of light.

The contact of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt against a lightsaber resulted in the smell of ozone.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
